text:
Piece Puzzle · 4-player individual match

1. Objective
Each player uses the same eight Pieces in five types to complete a grid of four rows crossing four columns.
Compete for your own survival. The first 3 players to submit a completed puzzle survive, and the last 1 is eliminated for good.
Each player works on their own board in private, without conversation, negotiation, or relationship reviews.

2. Notches and orientation
Each Piece has 4 notches. side 0 is a notch cut from the top, and side 1 is a notch cut from the bottom.
depth is the notch depth when the Piece height is taken as 100, and is one of 33, 58, or 83.
The two notches at each crossing must face opposite sides, top and bottom, and their depths must sum to at least 100.
Read the notches on row Pieces from left to right, and on column Pieces from top to bottom.
reverse=true reverses the notch order, and flip=true swaps the top and bottom directions of every notch.

3. Gameplay
Each turn, everyone simultaneously and privately chooses one action: place, remove, submit with the buzzer, or pass.
When placing a Piece, specify a position from 1 to 4 in a horizontal row or vertical col. You may reposition a Piece already on the board.
If another Piece occupies the chosen slot, it returns to the tray. Only a placed Piece can be removed.
Specify the final position and orientation for the Piece. The notch conditions at the crossings determine whether it fits.
Even with all 8 Pieces placed and all 16 crossings fitting, you must press the buzzer with submit to submit a completed puzzle.
After an incorrect submission, you can adjust your board and submit again.

4. Rankings
Players who submit a completed puzzle on an earlier turn rank higher. Ties on the same turn are decided by the draw order announced at the start.
The game ends once three survivors are determined, and all final boards are revealed. You cannot see other players' boards during the game.
Once the model-call limit is reached, play continues with scripted default actions. Malformed model actions are treated as passes.

K1 has no crossings, so there are currently no errors. Placing K4 flipped in column 1 gives the first crossing opposite notch sides and a combined depth of 141.

The existing crossing fits: the notches face opposite directions and their depths sum to 141. Placing K3 with a flip in column 2 joins a depth 83 notch to K4's depth 33 notch in the opposite direction.
The existing crossing satisfies the condition with depths 33 and 83. Placing K3 in vertical position 4 matches the 1/33 notch of K4 with the 0/83 notch of K3.
Reading K8 in reverse gives opposite notch sides at both crossings in column 1, with combined depths of 141 and 116 respectively. Add another Piece while keeping the board error-free.
The current crossing has oppositely facing notches whose depths sum to 141. Placing K3 in row 2 makes the first crossing fit with a depth sum of 116.
Both existing crossings fit. Placing K2 in row 2 gives opposite directions at the first two crossings, each with a depth sum of 141.
Both existing crossings fit. Placing K2 reversed in row 2 also gives opposite notch sides at columns 2 and 4, with combined depths of at least 100.
Both current crossings fit. Placing K5 with a flip in column 2 gives both crossings opposite notch directions, with depth sums of 116 and 141 respectively.
Both current crossings fit. Placing K2 in column 2 adds two fitting crossings, but the current K4 placement prevents row 4 from being completed, so a later adjustment is needed.
All four existing crossings fit. Placing K5 in column 4 makes both new crossings fit, and the remaining Pieces can complete the other slots.

All four existing crossings fit, and placing K7 in reverse in column 1 adds two more valid crossings. However, row 3 cannot be completed with the current arrangement, so orientations or positions will need adjusting later.
All four current crossings fit. Placing K2 in row 3 adds two fitting crossings; the final arrangement of the remaining Pieces still needs to be checked.
All four current crossings fit. Placing K5 flipped in row 4 makes both new crossings fit, and the remaining K7, K8, and K6 can complete the rest.
All six current crossings fit. After placing K6 in column 3, moving K2 to row 3 will allow the remaining Pieces to complete the grid.
All six current crossings fit. Placing K6 in column 3 adds two fitting crossings, and the existing arrangement can then be adjusted to complete the remaining rows.
All six current crossings fit. Placing K3 flipped in column 3 makes three crossings fit, but the existing arrangement will need adjustment to complete column 4.
All six current crossings fit. Placing K7 in row 3 fits the two existing columns, and K8 and K6 can fill the two remaining columns to complete the puzzle.
The only current error is at row 2, column 3. Flipping K2 in row 3 makes all four crossings fit, and the empty rows 2 and 4 can take K8 and flipped K7, respectively.
All eight of P09's existing crossings fit. Placing K8 reversed in row 4 also makes all four new crossings fit.
All 9 current crossings fit. Placing K7 in row 4 adds three more valid crossings, but completing column 4 will require adjusting the existing arrangement.
All 8 existing crossings fit. Placing K8 in column 3 makes four crossings fit, and placing K6 reversed and flipped in column 4 can complete the puzzle.
All eight of P13's existing crossings fit. Placing K8 in row 2 makes four crossings fit, and flipped K7 can fill the remaining row 4.
All 12 existing crossings fit, but placing K5 in the empty row 3 creates two incompatible crossings. I will place the final Piece first, then adjust the column arrangement.
All 12 current crossings fit. Placing K6 reversed in column 4 makes three of the four new crossings fit, but the row 1 crossing has a depth sum of 91 and needs a later adjustment.

All 12 existing crossings fit. Placing K7 with a flip in row 4 gives the remaining four crossings opposite notch directions and depth sums of at least 100.

P12 cannot submit because one crossing currently lacks enough depth. Reverse K4 to meet the depth requirement in column 4 and prepare for further adjustments.

All 8 of P13's Pieces are placed, and the verdict confirms that all 16 crossings fit. Submit immediately to secure a survival rank.
